# Deferred items at verify

Verify step 4 lists what `accord deferred <id>` prints in the report, and this follows the owner's answer at step 5. The items are findings and notes the work set aside; the owner decides which of them become backlog tickets, and nothing here blocks `accord gate done`.

1. Run `accord deferred <id>` again only when the ledger changed since the report. It prints one line per item, `Must: <text>` or `Should: <text>`, the Must items first, or `no Must or Should deferred items`. A Nice item is never shown. When it prints `no Must or Should deferred items`, ask nothing and go on to step 6.
2. Otherwise show the lines numbered and ask the owner one question as `./ask.md` says: which become backlog draft tickets, all, none or some by number? Say that an item left out stays in the ledger as a record, marked declined, and that finishing this ticket does not wait on the answer.
3. For each item the owner says yes to, run the queue route as `/accord queue <idea>` does, one draft ticket per item: a short English title, then `accord new ticket --queue --type <story|bug> --lane M --title "<title>" --note "<item>"`, with the item's ledger line, without its list marker, as the note; judge the similar tickets it prints and open its pull request as that skill says. Then append ` → <new id>` to the end of that item's line in `accord/tickets/<id>/ledger.md`. Read the new id as the word of the queue's `title:` line that, lower-cased, equals the part of its `branch:` line between `backlog/` and the closing `-<YYYY-MM-DD>`; when the similar check ended on an existing ticket the owner chose instead, it is the id of the existing ticket the owner chose. When the new id is only digits, append ` → #<new id>` instead, since a bare number after the arrow is read as prose, not as a mark.
4. An answer of none queues nothing. Append ` → declined` to the end of the line of each listed item the owner did not choose; every other item stays in the ledger as a record: append the mark only, and edit, move or rate no ledger line. Then run `accord deferred <id>` again until it prints `no Must or Should deferred items`; a line it still prints holds a mark to fix. The marks stay uncommitted until step 6 of `./verify.md`.
